title: Export or print a report
summary: Create a CSV with the report’s actual filters and download it when ready.

sections.title: Create and download a CSV
sections.body:
You need export permission as well as access to the selected report.

1. Open **Reports** and choose the correct report, dates, location, currency and filters.
2. Wait for the selected result to load, then select **Export CSV**.
3. Keep the export status visible while it prepares.
4. When **CSV ready** appears, select **Download CSV**.
5. Open the file and check the report and period before sharing it.

The export uses all matching authorized records, rather than only the displayed page. It does not expand your branch, personal-calendar or compensation access.

sections.title: Print a readable summary
sections.body:
Select **Print** to open the report’s printable summary. Use your browser’s printing options to print it or save a PDF. The summary can limit the displayed detail rows while retaining full filtered totals.

Use CSV when you need the complete matching data for further analysis. Keep financial and team information private when sharing or storing either format.

sections.title: If preparation or checking stops
sections.body:
If the status says it is still preparing, use **Check status** for that existing export. If checking failed, the export may still be running; check its status before starting another export.

Changing the selected report or filters changes the context. Create the export from the intended loaded result. If export access is unavailable, ask the owner to review your permissions rather than using another person’s account.
